name: 5. The Traveler Through Space and Time

steps.name: The Traveler Through Space and Time
steps.objective: Pass through "Hell's Door" into the "World Between Times", then find the person trapped inside.

steps.name: Siam's Call
steps.objective: Talk to "Siam", then turn in the quest to "Liz" on the "Wailing Coast".

lines.text: “Siam's Summons”

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: While using search magic to trace Iris Livier's whereabouts, I detected an unusual movement.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I am bound to this world, so I must ask you to investigate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: This place exists apart from the ordinary flow of time. It is usually filled with stillness and emptiness.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Those who walk the everyday world rarely visit here... Yet unexpected guests do sometimes appear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A being wreathed in searing heat, bearing a power full of contradictions.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Blind as I am, I cannot be certain, but I believe its flames were pitch-black.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A strange fire, seemingly both corrupted and sacred.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: ...In a battle long ago, just when we thought we had finally cornered the Demon King, a bird of flame appeared. It merged with him and lent him its power.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I could not mistake that ominous flickering... It must be the same being.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

choices.text: 1. Ask about the bird of flame.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It appears to be wounded now. I sensed it beating its wings through the emptiness of this vast world, scattering its own power in place of blood.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Then it vanished abruptly, as though erased. Where it had been, a doorway appeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Beyond it likely lies another world, one that has remained isolated until now...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Be careful. All that seeps from the other side is death and ruin... The scent of darkness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A dazzling light begins to pour from Siam's hand.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I will open the gate through time and space. I hope you find a clue.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Hold fast to your pride.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The story has been skipped. Traveling to the unknown land of Vanaheim.)
“The Wailing Coast”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Siam's magic brings you to a strangely unsettling shore.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The landscape is desolate. Something about it feels alien...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A strange feeling comes over you... As though someone is nearby.)

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Hello? Is someone there? Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A woman's voice comes from somewhere...!)

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Ah... Were you trying to reply?

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Since you cannot properly answer a communication spell, you must not be a mage of the Infinite Corridor.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Do you need help? I'm sorry, but I cannot come to your aid right now.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Head a little farther inland, away from the sea, and you will find an enormous tower. The area in front of it is safe.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: The road is dangerous, so be careful. If you aren't confident in your abilities... I pray you have a way to return.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Then... good luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The presence fades.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The story has been skipped.

steps.name: The Collapsed Tower
steps.objective: Talk to "Jade" on the third floor of the "Collapsed Tower" and turn in the quest.

lines.text: “The Collapsed Tower”

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: As I said, to state the conclusion first: Lord Einst's intuition was correct.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Let me explain what our investigation has uncovered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Ah... That is Lord Einst's special ability. I understand it is a power that awakens only rarely, even among the Storm Watchers. A unique perception that sees through to the truth of things.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: At its simplest, it can expose lies, or let its bearer instinctively grasp the right steps toward a desired future.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: That is the extent of my knowledge. The details are a secret among the Storm Watchers... Some say its abilities are even more extraordinary.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: With the Belpa priestess's help, I deciphered documents found in the tower. The language has much in common with those of Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I believe this land was once part of the continent of Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Its name was Vanaheim.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It was described as a land where spirits lived alongside the children of the goddess.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The goddess... That likely refers to the moon goddess. When the gods abandoned the world, she alone took pity on humanity, fought the Demon King, and perished.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Seres, Tyr, Arapea... There are various accounts of her name.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Judging from the name, I suspect the people who lived here were the Tyr.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: This tower...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...is a kind of enormous artifact. No sane mage could build such a thing. No one should!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jade falls silent, expression rigid. Then, with a sigh, Jade gives you an apologetic smile.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I'm sorry. I got carried away. Let me continue.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: If the legends of the Tyr are true, this tower had a purpose more terrible and wicked than one can imagine.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The tower is, in a sense, a furnace. And the material fed into it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jade hesitates briefly before continuing.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...is life itself.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: When the tower is activated, every living being inside loses its body. Only the soul is extracted.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Anyone without the strength to resist or endure it would have died, their mind shattered.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: How could anyone do something so horrific...?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...I cannot say for certain what they intended to do with that life force.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: But I wonder whether this was the Tyr's last resort in their battle against the Demon King...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: What in the world... did the Tyr do here?

choices.text: 4. Ask about the creatures of darkness and the girl's soul.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: What became of the Tyr who shed their bodies through this tower's magic remains a mystery. Their bodies, however, seem to have been left here.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Perhaps those strange, horrifying creatures are what remained after beings of darkness consumed those bodies.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: As you saw outside, this region is now utterly tainted by darkness. The earth, the water, the living things, even the wind... The Tyr bodies abandoned in this tower must have suffered the same fate.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Could the master of this dreadful darkness be the Demon King of legend—Beast?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: In other words, the Tyr used some terrible means to fight the Demon King here. As a result, their people were destroyed, and this land was permanently corrupted...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The girl's shattered soul may be a fragment of one sacrificed in that process. Perhaps her eyes see the Demon King from her nightmares, rather than us...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...It is only conjecture, but I've made this a very grim tale indeed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jade looks sorrowful.)

choices.text: 5. Ask about the bottom of the tower.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I sense the presence of an immensely powerful spirit on the tower's lowest floor.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Using a tower this enormous as a magical device defies common sense. It would require a being like the legendary Pluton Dragon.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Perhaps a being with power to rival a Spirit King helped the Tyr. And it remains trapped beneath the tower even now.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: If it helped the Tyr, it cannot have been evil by nature... But what waits below has become a host to darkness, endlessly spreading the aura of death through the tower.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I can still faintly sense something of its nature as a spirit... But it must have suffered for an eternity. Defeating it would be a mercy.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I will organize these findings and report them to Lord Einst. %s, there is an important mission I would like to entrust to you.

steps.name: Trapped in the Abyss
steps.objective: Defeat Njord on the lowest floor of the "Collapsed Tower", then report to [Jade] on the third floor.

steps.name: The Land of Beginnings
steps.objective: Go up to the "Collapsed Tower Top Floor" and talk to "Jade", then talk to the "Mage" at the "Collapsed Tower Entrance".

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...What is this sight...?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An enormous magical vortex looms before you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Large enough to sweep away everything around it, the vortex circles silently in place amid an incomprehensible stillness.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: That thing drifting around the vortex... Could something so enormous really be a magical artifact?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: And could it be...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For an instant, you think you see a shadow within the vortex.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...Did you see that? There appears to be something inside.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...An island...?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Impossible... This is nothing like Freios, shaped by the whims of beings from myth. No artificial magic could suspend a structure that enormous...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...No, what a foolish thing to say. Here and now, we are already in the realm of myth.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...It is frightening all over again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Despite those words, Jade's expression reveals excitement and a hint of delight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jade looks around and nods.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The documents said, “To ascend above, go to the top of the tower and tread the stairs of light.”

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I wondered what that meant. At least now we know where “above” is.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The stairs should pose no difficulty. If I reconstruct and activate the magic circles around here, we should be able to ascend to that place.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Please wait a moment. I'll restore the teleportation magic as quickly as I can.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Why did the Tyr abandon their bodies? Where did their souls go? What exactly happened...?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...I hope the answers lie up there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You leave this place in Jade's hands and decide to return for now.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (With one last glance at the sky, you think you see something like a feather dissolving into the air.)
